verdict.rationale: Solid's own README states it has full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration to reach interactivity quickly, and lists streaming SSR among its built-in features alongside Suspense. That directly matches streaming server-rendered content ahead of client code. The evidence is limited to README-level claims, with no detailed streaming API documentation or hands-on reports. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the streaming SSR APIs and how Suspense boundaries flush, independent or hands-on corroboration of perceived-load gains.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream server-rendered content so pages get faster perceived loads before all client code arrives

citations.quote: Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.
